name: Explain operating system internals and kernel mechanics
description: Users sought detailed technical explanations and solutions related to operating system internals, focusing on Linux kernel mechanisms, real-time operating systems, and embedded systems. The requests covered a wide range of topics including process and thread synchronization, memory management, device drivers, bootloaders, hardware interfaces, and debugging system-level errors.
